# Monetary headline guard grounding

Read-only inspection of `/Users/jamie/development/exposed-declared-headline` (PR103). No repository files or data changed.

## Existing flow and ownership

`exposed/src/lib/domain/models/entity_details.rs:213` defines `MemberSummary`; `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:65` builds it in `summarize_member` from the complete `MemberHistory` supplied by the repository. The service already owns exact historical sums across every category, separated by currency, and coverage counts. `BigDecimal` preserves exact amounts including zero, negatives, and repeated entries. No category filter controls this aggregate.

`exposed/src/lib/inbound/http/handlers/entity_details.rs:171` converts that summary into `MemberSummaryResponse`; decimal values become strings. GET `/members/{id}` is routed in `exposed/src/lib/inbound/http/routes.rs:13`. `frontend/src/lib/server/entity-details.ts:98` parses the response, and `frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:59` declares its typed frontend representation.

PR103's `frontend/src/lib/member-summary.ts:12` independently calculates both headline totals from raw declarations. It sums known GBP amounts across all categories; current term includes registration timestamps on/after `2024-07-09T00:00:00Z`, historical includes undated declarations too. `incomplete` means an unknown currency or a GBP entry with missing amount; a known foreign currency alone does not mark the GBP total incomplete. `declarationCount` distinguishes no declaration data from declarations with no known GBP amounts. `frontend/src/MemberIdentity.svelte:43` and `:70` render these states. Historical amount duplicates the backend's existing GBP summary.

## Narrow structural improvement

Make the backend service authoritative for both periods. Extend `MemberSummary` with typed declared headline period totals and an explicit parliament start boundary. Give one domain type/rule ownership of exact known-GBP accumulation and coverage; have both period aggregates use it, and avoid introducing a third independent historical amount implementation. Historical amount should agree with the existing GBP currency aggregate. Parse or construct the date boundary centrally, use an inclusive comparison, and keep the existing canonical category enum; headline totals include every category, including unknown source category IDs.

Serialize additive fields in `MemberSummaryResponse`, parse them strictly in `readMember`, and have `summarizeMember` pass those values to the existing view. Remove frontend `declaredTotal` and its headline date/filtering logic. Earnings timeline/category presentation can remain separate. This prevents a frontend-only category filter or Number sum from silently redefining a headline. It does not prevent a deliberate coordinated policy/test change; require explicit review for changes to this contract.

The affected API consumer is the Svelte server parser and its typed consumers (summary and history routes through shared detail loading). Update every mocked member response in frontend tests, notably `frontend/tests/entity-details.spec.ts`, and builder fixtures in `frontend/tests/member-summary.spec.ts`. External API clients accepting extra fields remain compatible; clients enforcing closed schemas may need updates. No other in-repository `/members/{id}` API consumer was found beyond the frontend and HTTP tests.

## Deterministic protection and existing test seams

Use fixed synthetic source records, not any real member's changing development-database total. Existing `exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details/fixtures/details.sql` already covers multiple category IDs, a misleading category label, unknown category 987, duplicate huge exact decimals, GBP negatives, canceling values, foreign currencies, missing amount/currency, empty declarations, undated declarations, and an empty member. It has no pre-term declarations: add a compact dedicated synthetic member or test-local fixture data spanning immediately before and exactly at the boundary. Use simple independently calculated expected totals that visibly differ from employment-only and support-only totals. Assert both values, counts, null/zero and incomplete states; undated records belong only to historical.

Existing `exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details/tests.rs:86` test `member_summary_covers_complete_history_and_classifies_by_source_id` exercises repository plus service. `:290` test `http_handlers_expose_typed_identities_exact_values_and_statuses` launches the real Axum routes and asserts JSON. Extend these to lock the authoritative fields and serialization with exact strings. All these tests use `#[sqlx::test(migrations = "../db/migrations", fixtures("details"))]`, so SQLx creates isolated test databases and applies migrations/fixtures. Supply a dedicated local test PostgreSQL administrator URL with database creation permission; never point it at imported production data. Example root command: `SQLX_OFFLINE=true DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost/exposed_contract_test cargo test -p exposed --lib outbound::entity_details::tests` (adjust local role/port credentials).

The frontend tests currently use `frontend/tests/backend.ts`, an HTTP stub behind a real built Svelte server; they do not call Rust. Existing tests alone therefore leave the cross-language contract unverified. Add one deterministic integration job/harness that obtains real Rust HTTP JSON from the isolated fixture database and drives the Svelte page against that API, asserting both headline labels/values and incomplete/no-data states. Alternatively export actual Rust fixture JSON during this test run and consume that exact artifact through the existing stub, rather than maintaining two handwritten expected payloads. A deliberately contradictory frontend payload test (raw declarations imply a different total than authoritative summary fields) additionally proves the UI renders the server total without recalculating it.

Frontend commands: `npm --prefix frontend run check`; `npm --prefix frontend test -- tests/member-summary.spec.ts tests/entity-details.spec.ts`. Browser installation is a prerequisite. These are proposed checks, not run in this read-only investigation.

## CI gap

`.github/workflows/rust.yml` triggers only for Rust/Cargo/.sqlx/workflow changes and runs Clippy on library/binaries; it does not run tests. No current workflow found runs these database or frontend contract tests. Add a PR check with disposable PostgreSQL, fixed fixture data, Rust HTTP contract assertions and frontend render assertions. Trigger it for both Rust and frontend changes, fixtures/migrations and the check itself. Make the contract check required in branch protection if the goal is enforcement: a test that agents can skip locally does not prevent merging a regression. Keep changes to amounts permitted when source records genuinely change; the fixed fixture checks preserve calculation semantics, not live totals.
